_comment: Version-specific binary facts for the Guest. Loaded at runtime by LiliesGuest (Mods/LiliesGuest/data/binary.json). Every function is armed only if the running EXE SHA-256 is listed below and the bytes at rva match prefix (fail-closed). Only functions without a reflection entry belong here. Verify offline with tools/verify_binary.py.

InputConsume.note: Consumes NextInputSnapshot(+184) into InputSnapshot(+224); the Guest overwrites InputSnapshot after the original runs. IDA.

GameplayCameraUpdate.note: Forced bLag=false so Lily keeps a fixed screen point in the exported frame. IDA.
